summary: J1 base used in the main assembly — KUKA KR3 base body (scale 0.49) hollowed out: ⌀81 bore up to the servo seat at z = 77 mm (MG996R hung from below: window, 4 M3 inserts, rib-relief slots), rear-box cavity for the Arduino Uno + 16-channel PWM shield, ⌀49.5 spigot recess and ⌀51–88 thrust ring at z = 90.45 mm for the turret, two tray pillars with M3 inserts, rear USB / DC-jack / cable openings, ⌀10 servo-cable hole through the box roof.

Electronics tray that closes the base from below — 2.5 mm plate (z = 6–8.5 mm in the base frame) with four Arduino Uno standoffs (pilot holes offset 0.2 mm toward -y of the post centres), two M3 holes for the base pillars and a rear lug with a horizontal M3 insert.

Not used in the main assembly (replaced by 01_Base_Kuka). J1 base pedestal part — 95 × 95 × 5 mm flange (4 mounting holes on 73.5 × 73.5 mm), ⌀82/⌀77 mm tower to 57 mm with 24 vent slots, MG996R servo ledge at 45.28 mm with 4× M3 heat-set insert holes.
J1 base top cap — ⌀82.2 × 4.5 mm disc with ⌀76.8 × 1.0 mm spigot; not used in the main assembly (the turret closes the tower).
Imported multi-body KUKA KR3 R540 reference model (51 bodies, scale 0.49) with only the rotating-column body shown; shape reference, not a designed turret.
Separate turret base disc ⌀82 × 10 mm with 25T horn pocket and 4 M3 inserts at (±30, ±15) mm; not used in the main assembly (its function is built into the turret) — it only fits the plain test fork.

One-piece J1–J2 turret in the same coordinate frame as the base — KUKA KR3 rotating-column body (scale 0.49) with its ⌀92 foot (face z = 90.65 mm) and ⌀49 spigot shortened to z = 86.1 mm: J1 horn seat at z = 91.85 mm with 4 M3 holes on PCD 14 and a ⌀22 access well from the channel floor; MG996R pocket tilted 15° in the +Y ear (seat plane y = 29.5 mm, 4 M3 insert holes, rib-relief slots), 698ZZ seat in the −Y ear; J1 axis = part Z axis, J2 axis at x = 9.8, z = 169.05 mm (h0 = 169.05 mm, a1 = 9.8 mm); the rear boss is cut into a vertical wire eyelet above the base wire hole.
Turret sub-assembly — KUKA-style fork with the J2 MG996R, 25T horn and 698ZZ bearing placed by fixed transforms.
13 mm test-print slice of the KUKA-style fork servo ear (y = 21–34 mm) — servo window, tab seat, rib-relief slots and 4 insert holes — for checking the MG996R fit before printing the full fork.

Upper arm (L1 = 127.4 mm) — KUKA KR3 link-arm body (scale 0.49) in the same coordinate frame as the fork: J2 hub cut to the horn face y = 14.65 mm (4× M3 on PCD 14) with a through access cavity and M8 nut trap on the bearing side; J3 fork with an MG996R pocket tilted 15° in the +Y ear (seat y = 30.7 mm, 4 M3 inserts, rib-relief slots) and a 698ZZ seat in the −Y ear; a 9 x 6 mm wire duct with a 3 mm press-in slit along the back (z = 180 to 245 mm); J2 axis at z = 169.05, J3 axis at z = 296.45 mm.
Printed spacer ring ⌀11 / ⌀8.3 × 5.55 mm between the J2 698ZZ inner race and the upper-arm hub.

Forearm elbow block around J3 — KUKA KR3 elbow body (scale 0.49) in the arm frame: servo-side face cut to y = 21.7, recessed horn pocket (bottom y = 15.85) with 4x M3 holes, rear-opening screw cavity, bearing-side face y = -24.0 with M8 hole, nut pocket and 4 hex-key access holes; front recess with 4 M3 insert holes and a wire hole for the fork body.

Forearm fork body — KUKA KR3 forearm solid (scale 0.49): centring boss that seats in the elbow block recess, side-opening wiring cavity, 4x M3 joint holes and a wire hole through the rear wall, 4 hex-key access holes through the front wall; J4 MG90S mount in the +Y arm (through window, 2.7 mm tab recess, 2 tab-screw pilot holes) with the shaft on the J4 axis at x = 137.2, z = 306.23 mm; M3 insert holes for the two side covers and a wire slot from the +Y face into the wiring cavity.

Forearm -Y side cover and second fork arm — KUKA KR3 cover solid (scale 0.49) with a dia 8.4 bore on the J4 axis for the pivot pin, a counterbore for the pin flange, 3 counterbored M3 holes into the fork body and a 0.3 mm relief notch on the rear edge that clears the fork-body lug.
Forearm +Y side cover — KUKA KR3 cover solid (scale 0.49) cut flat at y = 28.45 mm, with an open window around the J4 MG90S body, a wire channel on the inner face and 3 screw holes into the fork arm.
J4 pivot pin — dia 12 x 2 mm flange, dia 8 x 13.7 mm shaft, dia 3.4 axial hole; runs in the pivot cover bore and is held in the wrist by an M3 x 20 screw.

Wrist body — KUKA KR3 wrist solid (scale 0.49): side bosses trimmed for 0.5 mm gaps, J4 axis at x = 137.2, z = 306.23 mm with a two-arm MG90S horn recess on the +Y face and a dia 8.3 pivot hole with an M3 insert hole at its bottom on the -Y face; front-loading J5 MG90S pocket (body, tab slot, wire slot) with a flat belly pad and a screw lug under it for the one tab-screw pilot hole; J5 roll axis at y = 0, z = 306.23 mm, intersecting J4 on the centre of the KUKA wrist nose.

Gripper base — one rounded-rectangle body (39 x 44.5 mm, R6 corners, same section as the rack guide) with an R19.5 collar on the rear face that sleeves over the wrist nose; seats on the J5 MG90S two-arm horn (horn recess and centre-screw hole on the rear face) and carries the gripper MG90S in a front-loading pocket with its shaft on the roll axis; the gripper parts share a frame whose roll axis is at y = 0, z = 301.0 mm and which the assembly places on the wrist J5 axis (z = 306.23 mm); 4 M3 heat-set insert holes in the front face for the rack guide and a wire drop channel through the bottom.
Gripper pinion — module 1.5, 10 teeth, on a dia 33 carrier disc with a recess for the uncut MG90S two-arm horn; drawn in the gripper frame on the roll axis.

Gripper jaw (print two; the second is the same part turned 180 deg about the J5 axis) — module 1.5 rack (flanks relieved 0.12 mm for backlash) with a guide tongue on its back and a 6 x 34 x 30 mm finger centred on the J5 axis and tapered to a 3 x 15 mm tip with a V-groove in the grip face, drawn in the closed position.

Gripper rack guide — open-front box (back plate, two side walls, roof and floor with tongue grooves, extended forward to support the finger roots, R6 outer corners matching the base) bolted to the gripper base with 4 M3 screws into heat-set inserts.

Main assembly of the whole arm — KUKA base with tray, Arduino Uno and the PCA9685 shield stacked 11.5 mm above it (both placed 0.2 mm off the bay centre to clear the J1 servo), J1 MG996R + horn, one-piece turret, J2 DS3225 servo + horn, 698ZZ + spacer, KUKA-style upper arm, J3 MG996R + horn, the forearm elbow block and the fork body seated in it (concentric + coincident, free to turn about the forearm axis in CAD; bolted with 4 screws on the real robot), the J4 MG90S and both side covers locked to the fork body, the wrist body with the J5 MG90S and the J4 pivot pin locked to it, the gripper (base on the J5 axis with its MG90S and rack guide locked to it, pinion on the gripper servo shaft, two rack jaws sliding in the guide, each tied to the pinion by a rack-pinion mate (pitch dia 15 mm) and kept on it by a 0-23.6 mm limit-distance mate); base, tray, J1 servo + horn and Uno are fixed, the turret, upper-arm and elbow groups the wrist and the gripper base rotate on J1 / J2 / J3 / J4 / J5 mates (concentric + coincident/distance, hardware locked to its link); table at y = 0, J1 on the Y axis, J2 axis at x = 9.8, y = 169.05 mm.

Plain test-print fork for checking the MG996R fit — ⌀82 × 6 mm floor, 7 mm servo ear plate (40.6 × 20.7 mm opening, 4 M3 inserts), 8 mm bearing ear with 698ZZ seat, 44 mm gap; J2 axis 27.95 mm above its bottom. Not part of the main assembly.
Test sub-assembly — plain fork with the J2 MG996R (mated), 25T horn and 698ZZ bearing.
J1 base working assembly — pedestal, MG996R, top cap, 25T horn and 4 M3 inserts.
+Y half of the KUKA rotating-column body (split from 02_Base_Turret at y = 0, cut at z = 100 mm) with trial cuts and bosses; styling reference for the turret fork.
